name: Si fraction of admissible area
definition: Si area / admissible area (admissible = not graphite, not artefact)
failure_signature: shift vs baseline = Si loading or segmentation change; read before every other KPI

name: Si number density
definition: Si objects per 1000 um2 admissible area
failure_signature: fewer, larger objects at equal K01 = agglomeration

name: Si object size
definition: Equivalent-circle diameter D50/D90/max of Si objects (2D section sizes; relative use only)
failure_signature: D90/max up at stable D50 = a tail of agglomerates

name: Agglomerate fraction
definition: Si mask dilated by d/2 -> components = clusters (touching or within d); share of Si area in clusters with ECD > d*. v0 d=0.5 um, d*=5 um, sweep logged
failure_signature: rises when Si groups into clusters

name: Voronoi cell-area spread
definition: SD of mean-normalised Voronoi cell areas of Si centroids, cells restricted to admissible pixels, border cells dropped; compared to random-labelling null; plus CV of per-object local Si area fraction (SKIZ)
failure_signature: sigma above null = clustered; below = regular

name: Voronoi cluster / void regions
definition: Area fraction of admissible space in cells with normalised area < 0.5 (cluster) and > 2.0 (Si-depleted)
failure_signature: both rise together when Si is clumped

name: Nearest-neighbour index
definition: R_rl = observed mean NN distance / mean NN under random labelling in admissible space; R_csr = classical Clark-Evans for literature comparison
failure_signature: R < 1 clustered, R > 1 regular

name: Pair correlation excess
definition: Directional g(r) (pair sectors within 30 deg of x or z), r = 0.25-10 um; max excess above the 97.5% random-labelling envelope and the r where it peaks
failure_signature: positive excess at small r = clusters of that size

name: Minimum spanning tree
definition: Mean and SD of MST edge lengths over Si centroids, normalised by sqrt(admissible area / n)
failure_signature: low m with high sigma = clustered (Dussert m-sigma plane)

name: Scale-of-segregation curve
definition: CV of local Si fraction (Si px / admissible px) in non-overlapping windows w = 1, 2, 5, 10, 20 um (windows with admissible fraction >= 0.5); summary = CV at 10 um and log-log slope
failure_signature: flat or slowly decaying curve = segregated regions of size ~w (headline curve)

name: Lacey mixing index
definition: M = (s0^2 - s^2)/(s0^2 - sR^2) at w = 10 um; s0^2 = p(1-p), sR^2 = p(1-p)/N, N = expected Si objects per window
failure_signature: M well below 1 = segregated at 10 um scale

name: Through-thickness profile
definition: Admissible-normalised Si fraction in 5 equal depth bands; summary = max |band - mean| / mean and |slope| / mean. Sign undetermined (no Cu foil in frame)
failure_signature: large deviation or slope = Si migrated toward one face

name: Lateral uniformity
definition: CV of admissible-normalised Si fraction over 10 um column bins; read together with A02
failure_signature: high CV with low A02 = lateral Si streaks

name: Empty space
definition: P50 and P95 distance from admissible pixels to nearest Si pixel (um)
failure_signature: P95 up = Si-free pockets

name: Si-graphite contact
definition: Share of Si boundary pixels with a graphite 4-neighbour
failure_signature: drop = Si sitting in pores/binder, away from graphite

name: Si-to-graphite distance
definition: Median over Si objects of the min distance from the object to graphite (um)
failure_signature: rise = Si detached from graphite network

name: Graphite by depth
definition: Graphite area fraction mean and max band deviation over 5 depth bands
failure_signature: calendering / settling signature

name: Graphite orientation spread
definition: Area-weighted circular SD of graphite object major-axis angle (doubled-angle statistics), deg
failure_signature: narrower = stronger calendering alignment

name: Graphite size and shape
definition: Graphite object ECD D50 and median aspect ratio
failure_signature: shift alone = raw-material lot

name: Porosity by depth
definition: Pore area fraction mean and max band deviation over 5 depth bands
failure_signature: calendering / drying signature

name: Pore size proxy
definition: D50 of 2 x Euclidean distance transform over pore pixels (um)
failure_signature: densification

name: Pore connectivity
definition: Euler number of pore mask (8-connectivity) per 1000 um2
failure_signature: connectivity change

name: Large voids
definition: Area fraction of isolated large voids flagged and masked before Si KPIs
failure_signature: pull-out / cracks; high values make Si KPIs unreliable

name: Curtaining index
definition: SD of BSE column-mean intensity after median-filter detrending (201 px)
failure_signature: high = milling streaks that can fake lateral localisation

name: Slice height
definition: Image height in um (proxy for coating thickness if crops = coating)
failure_signature: context only

name: Two-point cluster function
definition: C2(r) decay length along x and z
failure_signature: longer = larger connected Si clusters

name: Euler dilation merge radius
definition: Dilation radius at which the Euler number of the Si mask halves
failure_signature: smaller = Si objects closer together

name: Persistent homology H0
definition: Lifetime median / IQR of H0 features under signed-distance filtration
failure_signature: many short-lived features = crowding

name: Si streak anisotropy
definition: Minkowski-tensor beta of Si mask
failure_signature: alignment of Si streaks
